title: Recordings with Buck Clayton and Moustache
summary: They sort out where recordings with Moustache and the Mezzrow group were made.

blocks.x: So -- in trying to get the sequence of things. You were in Italy actually before you went to -- back to France. When some of these recordings were made with Buck Clayton --
That was recorded -- especially "Saints" was recorded in Strasbourg, Germany.
No, it was Strasbourg, France, it's right on the borden of Germany. And the other was in France, Avalon. That was recorded with Moustache in Paris.
That's right. With Claude Bolling and Joe Daly on vibraphone?
Guy Loneau was a trumpet player
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
A beautiful guy. All the French guys were great.
But there is another recording where you're playing with Moustache's Jazz 7.
That's the same group. That's the group that we had in the summer of fifty -- oh, I can't think.

'52 or '53, but anyway that was the same band that we used at the Palm Beach Casino. At the same time I was at the Casino, Billy Daniels came through and he was staying at the Carlton where all the tourists stayed, Palm Beach Carlton. Also Wally Simpson came there, as well as the big gambling.
